The Mindset

Design is Not Just What It Looks Like. It Is How It Scales.

A balanced approach merging rigorous design thinking with frontend performance engineering.

From Design Systems to Production Code

Over the past 8+ years, I have worked alongside venture-backed founders, engineering vice presidents, and product directors to transform fragmented interfaces into coherent, unified digital design systems.

My background spans both ends of the digital spectrum: architecting pixel-precise component systems in Figma, and implementing them directly in clean semantic HTML5, modern CSS custom properties, and performant Vanilla JavaScript. This dual fluency eliminates developer handoff friction and ensures that what is designed is precisely what ships to users.

📍 San Francisco, CA (PST • UTC-8)
